objectives.title: Improve director scoring for cinematic social footage
acceptance: static or parked footage is scored below comparable moving action footage
very long clips do not receive a higher duration score than a social-friendly medium clip
preserve scoreMedia export and existing contracts
constraints: do not rewrite the scoring function wholesale

objectives.title: Expand motorcycle and vehicle subject recognition
acceptance: scooter, moped and ATV footage is classified as vehicle
preserve existing motorcycle, car and person classifications
constraints: make the smallest coherent rule change
